text_block_list.text:
The highest-difficulty yoga pose... Heheh, 
bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Raise the legs... arms, too... ngh! 
...N-Now, lastly... wrap them around the 
neck――"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The highest difficulty... is no joke, 
huh...
